title: Start here: VMM current baselines and non-negotiables
summary: Vector Meridian Markets is a separate principal market-maker and direct institutional OTC manufacturer. Current runtime baseline is VMM v0.11; current separate operator UI baseline is Wire UI Web v0.3. Preserve legal, queue, accounting and UI authority boundaries before adding features.
invariants: Do not fold VMM into FederationBank Core/Retail or Merchant Banking.
Federation relationships are explicit arm's-length contracts or Queue Fabric message boundaries, never inherited authority.
Do not replace a newer VMM/UI candidate with an older copy merely because a later roll-up happens to bundle it.
Operational, accounting and browser projection truth remain separate authority layers.

provenance.claim: Current VMM v0.11 runtime/legal/protocol/reporting baseline and qualification target.
UI v0.3 is separate from runtime v0.11 and carries the @3 semantic/operator application baseline.
